items.title: SemiAnalysis releases GDPx, an agentic benchmark across 11 high-value domains where the best model scores 12%
items.summary: GDPx is 206 expert-built agentic tasks across 11 domains (chip design, cyber, biology, finance, legal, quant trading, materials science, alignment, software engineering and more), made with 14 data partners, with a public leaderboard, rollouts and a cost vs score Pareto view. Claude Opus 5.5 leads at 12.0%, Gemini 4 Carbon 10.9% at about a third of the cost per task, GPT-6 Astra 9.6%; SemiAnalysis also reports a ranking with the cyber, bio and alignment domains removed because safety classifiers depress some models' scores.

doubt.pushback: Repliers say the overall ranking is partly a refusal-rate chart because safety classifiers cut scores in cyber, bio and alignment, and one asks SemiAnalysis to disclose ties to the mostly brand-new data-partner companies.

reception.summary: Mostly positive about a hard, low-ceiling benchmark and the cost view (Carbon near Opus at a third the price); criticism centers on safety-classifier sandbagging, task counts per domain, keeping tasks private, and partner disclosure. Many quotes are from the data partners themselves.

items.title: Hermes Agent completes 9 of 10 everyday tasks fully offline with a local model over a unix socket
items.summary: A hands-on test ran Hermes Agent with no network and the model served on the same machine through a unix socket: file edits, fixing a failing test and log analysis worked with zero outbound packets, and the one web-fetch task failed gracefully. The write-up with the setup is in an open bench repo.
items.vendor: Nous Research (Hermes Agent); test by witcheer

doubt.pushback: Single-person test of 10 tasks; no independent replication yet.

items.title: LiteLLM ships a Unified Cost Accounting Engine for budgets and spend reports
items.summary: The LiteLLM gateway moves cost tracking to one accounting engine with dedicated analytics workers, so budgets and reports agree and spend can be sliced by team, user, model or custom dimensions.
